record.field: [BACKUP ALERT] Database Backup Failed: {{ object.name }} ({{ ctx.get('db_name') or object.db_name }})
Sent to configured administrators when automated or manual database backup fails

div.style: font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #333333; margin: 0px; padding: 20px;
background-color: #d9534f; color: #ffffff; padding: 15px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold;

div.p: The database backup for profile Production Backup encountered an error and could not complete.

pre.style: background-color: #f8f9fa; border: 1px solid #e9ecef; border-left: 4px solid #d9534f; padding: 12px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px; overflow-x: auto; white-space: pre-wrap;

t.t-out: ctx.get('error_message') or 'Unknown error occurred during backup execution.'

div.p: Please inspect the backup configuration and server storage to resolve this issue.
